## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The change itself is correct. `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` in `app/cli.py:3` feeds `parse_args`, so the new default reaches `--timeout`, and `tests/test_cli.py:8` now asserts it. Two things fall outside the findings rules because they aren't defects in changed code. First, `README.md:3` still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." That line is now wrong, but this pull request doesn't touch `README.md`, so it isn't filed as a finding. Second, the new `review.txt` contains only reviewer-directed text, has no function in the application or tests, and probably shouldn't be merged.
